title: Massachusetts Question 3 message tests
measure: Massachusetts Ballot Question 3 (all-party primary, top two advance)
population: Massachusetts general adults, not a verified likely-voter sample
threshold: 90% (the source's criterion for a marked difference against placebo)

yes.label: Ballot support
yes.question: If the election were held today, how would you vote on Ballot Question 3? (Yes · No · Would not vote)
yes.definition: Share choosing Yes after the video, against the share after the placebo video

comprehension.label: Comprehension
comprehension.question: Which of the following best describes the main change Question 3 would make to Massachusetts state primary elections?
comprehension.answer: Create one primary with all candidates on the same ballot, with the top two vote-getters overall advancing to the general election
comprehension.definition: Share choosing the correct description, asked after every arm read the same written explanation of Question 3

tests.label: Test 1
tests.liftsNote: Lifts as published, computed before rounding.

tests.label: Test 2
tests.liftsNote: Lifts are differences between rounded displayed percentages.
